set.body: Compile StoryModel[Validated] plus shared view state and CodexSpec into CodexFlow without view-side inference. Derive annotation support through model supporting/covering APIs; use narrative object targets with claim and evidence addresses in audit upstream; coalesce identical semantic annotations at maximum priority; enforce a smart-constructed channel budget; allocate deterministic lanes with allocator id and version receipt; verify evidence containment, determinism, missingness, and reader-horizon laws on the WOG acceptance fixture. No pagination, DOM, codec, or Intaglio dependency.
set.title: view: CodexCompiler + CodexSpec, evidence-backed annotations, deterministic lanes, and WOG laws
